title: PostgreSQL - pgBadger Live Overview (PromQL Updated)
description: Live PostgreSQL monitoring inspired by pgBadger. Metrics are from postgres_exporter; log panels are from Alloy-ingested postgresql_logs. Cumulative counters are shown as cumulative values, not per-second rates. Includes PromQL health, transaction rate, cache-hit ratio, deadlock rate, temporary write rate, and database size in GiB.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_database_size_bytes" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_activity_count" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_activity_max_tx_duration" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_locks_count" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_database_deadlocks" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_database_blks_hit" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_database_blks_read" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_database_xact_commit" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_database_xact_rollback" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_database_temp_bytes" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_bgwriter_checkpoints_timed_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_bgwriter_checkpoints_req_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_statements_calls_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_stat_statements_seconds_total" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_wal_size_bytes" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS "x_axis_1", max(value) AS "y_axis_1" FROM "pg_exporter_last_scrape_error" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT _timestamp, host, message FROM "postgresql_logs" WHERE message LIKE '%duration:%' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT _timestamp, host, message FROM "postgresql_logs" WHERE message LIKE '%ERROR%' OR message LIKE '%FATAL%' OR message LIKE '%PANIC%' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT _timestamp, host, message FROM "postgresql_logs" WHERE message LIKE '%deadlock%' OR message LIKE '%lock wait%' ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT _timestamp, host, job, service, filename, message FROM "postgresql_logs" ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100
pg_up

panels.title: Transactions per Second
panels.description: Committed plus rolled-back transactions per second by database.

queries.query: sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_xact_commit[5m]) + rate(pg_stat_database_xact_rollback[5m]))

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio (%)
panels.description: Shared buffer cache hit percentage by database.

queries.query: 100 * sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_blks_hit[5m]) + rate(pg_stat_database_blks_read[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: Deadlocks per Second
panels.description: Rate of deadlock counters by database.

queries.query: sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_deadlocks[5m]))

panels.title: Temporary Data Written (bytes/sec)
panels.description: Rate of temporary bytes written by database.

queries.query: sum by (datname) (rate(pg_stat_database_temp_bytes[5m]))

panels.title: Exporter Scrape Error
panels.description: 1 indicates the latest PostgreSQL exporter scrape failed.

queries.query: pg_exporter_last_scrape_error

panels.title: Database Size (GiB)
panels.description: Database sizes converted from bytes to gibibytes.

queries.query: sum by (datname) (pg_database_size_bytes) / 1073741824
